title: MZ Hey hey everyone – a (slightly delayed) introduction

posts.author: Nicikeller
posts.body:
Hi all, Nici here.
I actually used my first RPG Maker 20+ years ago (RPG Maker 2000) and now, after 3 years on MV, I migrated my project to MZ, which now I'm on for 2-3 years. I spent this time mostly on german speaking RPG Maker forums (because I'm Swiss and hence German is my first language), but happy to formally join the global community now.
To be honest, I think I made my first "need some help with this error" post on the forum a few years ago, and I only yesterday introduced myself proberly, but together with me project
The Last Night Train
in the "Games Under Development" section (
here
), because I didn't realise there is this separate Introduction thread - but better late than never
I also love to play games, more than RPGs I am into Story & Puzzle Games (To the Moon, Ghost Story, Undertale style) and that's also what I create, so happy for any such Story + puzzle game tips, especially in the RPG Maker style.
Kind Regards
Nici
